title: Go Tell It on the Mountain
author: James Baldwin
summary: On his fourteenth birthday in 1935 Harlem, John Grimes faces his stern preacher stepfather and the church. The novel moves back through the lives of his family, tracing their pain and faith.
readIf: you want a short, lyrical novel about faith, family and race in America.
skipIf: you prefer light reading or find religious themes and family cruelty hard going.
